message:
I remember the time I thought a flashlight and a few candles would cover my emergency needs. It turned into a bit of a comedy show when the power went out, and I was left fumbling around in the dark, tripping over the cat and knocking over a plant or two. 

It's funny how we can easily overlook the basics until we're in a pinch. That's why I found this resource on making a family emergency plan to be so helpful. It’s a gentle reminder that a little preparation can go a long way in keeping our loved ones safe and sound. 

So, what’s your go-to emergency snack? I’d love to hear!
